import ast,copy,json,pathlib,types
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
runner=root/'TestArtifacts/FightMatch/UGUI-01/q4-correction-19-source/validation-tools/runner.py'
text=runner.read_text()
tree=ast.parse(text)
names={'supervise_root','settle_owned','verify_owned','unity_rows'}
selected=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name in names]
assert {n.name for n in selected}==names
ns={}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=selected,type_ignores=[]),str(runner)+' [isolated control functions]','exec'),ns)
monitor=ns['supervise_root'];settle=ns['settle_owned']
class Clock:
 def __init__(self,t=0):self.t=t;self.waits=[]
 def now(self):return self.t
 def wait(self,seconds):
  assert 0<=seconds<=1.000001
  self.waits.append(seconds);self.t+=seconds
def state(rows):return dict(ownedProcesses=copy.deepcopy(rows),unownedUnityProcesses=[])
def allowed(row):return dict(allowed=True,gone=False)
cases=[]
# Replay the real FIX18 post-exit wait block with a fake clock and lingering child.
old=(root/'TestArtifacts/FightMatch/UGUI-01/q4-correction-18/validation-tools/runner.py').read_text()
a=old.index("    deadline=(start+TIMEOUT if not run['timedOut']")
b=old.index('    final=observe(True)',a)
fragment='\n'.join(line[4:] for line in old[a:b].splitlines())
observed=json.loads((root/'TestArtifacts/FightMatch/UGUI-01/q4-correction-18/run.json').read_text())['launchToExitObservationSeconds']
clock=Clock(observed)
scope=dict(start=0,TIMEOUT=600,run=dict(timedOut=False),time=types.SimpleNamespace(monotonic=clock.now,sleep=clock.wait),
           final=dict(ownedProcesses=[dict(pid=7)],unityProcesses=[]),
           observe=lambda:dict(ownedProcesses=[dict(pid=7)],unityProcesses=[]))
exec(compile(fragment,'FIX18 post-exit branch replay','exec'),scope)
assert clock.t==600 and clock.t>observed+90
cases.append(dict(case='FIX18_actual_post_exit_branch_replay',expected='regression reproduced',rootExitSeconds=observed,monitorStoppedSeconds=clock.t,promptCleanupGate=False))
# The fixed monitor returns immediately on nonzero exit; cleanup has a separate deadline.
clock=Clock(observed);alive=True;sent=[];gentle_calls=[]
outcome=monitor(lambda:1,lambda:None,lambda:None,clock.wait,clock.now,600)
first=copy.deepcopy(outcome)
def snap():return state([dict(pid=7,compilerServer=True)] if alive else [])
def gentle(row,proof):
 gentle_calls.append(row['pid']);return dict(status='REQUEST_SENT')
def terminate(row,proof):
 global alive
 sent.append(row['pid']);alive=False;return dict(sent=True,pid=row['pid'])
cleanup=settle(outcome['kind'],1,snap,allowed,gentle,terminate,clock.wait,clock.now)
assert outcome==first and first['kind']=='ROOT_EXIT_NONZERO' and first['elapsedSeconds']==observed
assert cleanup['status']=='COMPLETE' and abs(cleanup['durationSeconds']-60)<0.001 and sent==[7]
assert clock.t<observed+91 and clock.t<600
cases.append(dict(case='early_nonzero_exit_and_stubborn_compiler',firstFailure=first,cleanup=cleanup['status'],cleanupSeconds=cleanup['durationSeconds'],signals=sent))
# Compilation failure is observed while the root is still live; later cleanup cannot replace it.
clock=Clock(10);calls=[];alive=True
outcome=monitor(lambda:None,lambda:dict(line='error CS0234'),lambda:None,clock.wait,clock.now,600)
first=copy.deepcopy(outcome)
def snap_transient():
 if not alive:return state([])
 if clock.t<11:return state([dict(pid=1,compilerServer=False),dict(pid=7,compilerServer=True)])
 return state([dict(pid=7,compilerServer=True)])
def gentle_exit(row,proof):
 global alive
 calls.append(row['pid']);alive=False;return dict(status='REQUEST_SENT')
cleanup=settle(outcome['kind'],1,snap_transient,allowed,gentle_exit,lambda r,p:dict(sent=False),clock.wait,clock.now)
assert outcome==first and outcome['kind']=='COMPILE_FAILURE' and outcome['elapsedSeconds']==10
assert cleanup['status']=='COMPLETE' and cleanup['durationSeconds']<=2 and calls==[7] and not cleanup['signalsSent']
cases.append(dict(case='compile_error_before_root_exit_transient_children',firstFailure=first,cleanupSeconds=cleanup['durationSeconds'],gentleCalls=calls,signals=[]))
clock=Clock(42)
outcome=monitor(lambda:0,lambda:None,lambda:None,clock.wait,clock.now,600)
cleanup=settle(outcome['kind'],1,lambda:state([]),allowed,lambda r,p:None,lambda r,p:None,clock.wait,clock.now)
assert outcome['kind']=='ROOT_EXIT_ZERO' and cleanup['status']=='COMPLETE' and clock.t==42
cases.append(dict(case='success_lifecycle_only',outcome=outcome,cleanup=cleanup['status'],testPassClaim=False))
clock=Clock();alive=True;signals=[];gentle_calls=[]
outcome=monitor(lambda:None,lambda:None,lambda:None,clock.wait,clock.now,600)
def timeout_snap():return state([dict(pid=1,compilerServer=False)] if alive else [])
def timeout_term(row,proof):
 global alive
 signals.append(dict(pid=row['pid'],at=clock.t));alive=False;return dict(sent=True,pid=row['pid'])
cleanup=settle(outcome['kind'],1,timeout_snap,allowed,lambda r,p:gentle_calls.append(r['pid']),timeout_term,clock.wait,clock.now)
assert outcome['kind']=='TIMEOUT' and outcome['elapsedSeconds']==600
assert cleanup['status']=='COMPLETE' and clock.t==660 and signals==[dict(pid=1,at=660)] and gentle_calls==[]
cases.append(dict(case='timeout_natural60_then_one_root_SIGTERM',outcome=outcome,cleanupSeconds=cleanup['durationSeconds'],signals=signals))
clock=Clock();signals=[]
cleanup=settle('TIMEOUT',1,lambda:state([dict(pid=1,compilerServer=False)]),allowed,
              lambda r,p:None,lambda r,p:(signals.append(r['pid']) or dict(sent=True,pid=r['pid'])),clock.wait,clock.now)
assert cleanup['status']=='BLOCKED_MANUAL_PROCESS_CLEANUP' and clock.t==90 and signals==[1]
cases.append(dict(case='stubborn_after_SIGTERM',cleanup=cleanup['status'],seconds=clock.t,signals=signals))
# Exercise the actual PID/argv/tool/ancestry guard with fake process identities.
base=dict(pid=7,birth='recorded birth',command='recorded complete argv',comm='/trusted/dotnet',queryExitCodes=[0,0,0])
tool=dict(files=[dict(path='/trusted/dotnet',bytes=1,sha256='frozen')],compilerServer=True)
saved=dict(base,tools=tool)
ns['os']=types.SimpleNamespace(getpid=lambda:999)
for mismatch in ['pid','birth','command','tools','ancestry']:
 current=copy.deepcopy(base);observed_tools=copy.deepcopy(tool);ancestry=dict(origin='Unity',chain=[7,1])
 if mismatch=='pid':current['pid']=8
 elif mismatch=='birth':current['birth']='reused PID birth'
 elif mismatch=='command':current['command']='foreign argv'
 elif mismatch=='tools':observed_tools['files'][0]['sha256']='changed tool'
 else:ancestry['chain']=[7,888]
 ns['current_identity']=lambda pid,c=current:copy.deepcopy(c)
 ns['owned_tool_identity']=lambda info,t=observed_tools:copy.deepcopy(t)
 proof=ns['verify_owned'](dict(pid=7),saved,ancestry,1)
 assert not proof['allowed']
 clock=Clock();signals=[]
 cleanup=settle('ROOT_EXIT_NONZERO',1,lambda:state([dict(pid=7,compilerServer=True)]),
                lambda row,p=proof:p,lambda r,p:None,
                lambda r,p:signals.append(r['pid']),clock.wait,clock.now)
 assert cleanup['status']=='BLOCKED_PROCESS_IDENTITY' and not signals
 cases.append(dict(case='identity_mismatch_'+mismatch,checks=proof['checks'],signals=signals,cleanup=cleanup['status']))
clock=Clock();signals=[]
cleanup=settle('ROOT_EXIT_NONZERO',1,lambda:state([dict(pid=7,compilerServer=False)]),allowed,
              lambda r,p:None,lambda r,p:dict(sent=False,gone=False,pid=r['pid']),
              clock.wait,clock.now)
assert cleanup['status']=='BLOCKED_PROCESS_IDENTITY' and not cleanup['signalsSent']
cases.append(dict(case='identity_changes_before_signal',seconds=clock.t,signals=cleanup['signalsSent'],cleanup=cleanup['status']))
clock=Clock()
cleanup=settle('ROOT_EXIT_NONZERO',1,lambda:dict(ownedProcesses=[dict(pid=7)],unownedUnityProcesses=[dict(pid=888)]),
              allowed,lambda r,p:None,lambda r,p:None,clock.wait,clock.now)
assert cleanup['status']=='BLOCKED_UNOWNED_PROCESS' and not cleanup['signalsSent'] and clock.t==0
cases.append(dict(case='unowned_Unity_process',cleanup=cleanup['status'],signals=[]))

clock=Clock(600.01)
outcome=monitor(lambda:0,lambda:None,lambda:None,clock.wait,clock.now,600)
assert outcome['kind']=='TIMEOUT'
cases.append(dict(case='late_zero_exit_does_not_pass_budget',outcome=outcome))
clock=Clock(12)
outcome=monitor(lambda:None,lambda:dict(line='error CS0234'),lambda:None,clock.wait,clock.now,600)
first=copy.deepcopy(outcome)
cleanup=settle(outcome['kind'],1,lambda:state([dict(pid=7,compilerServer=True)]),
              lambda r:dict(allowed=False,gone=False),lambda r,p:None,lambda r,p:None,clock.wait,clock.now)
assert outcome==first and cleanup['status']=='BLOCKED_PROCESS_IDENTITY' and not cleanup['signalsSent']
cases.append(dict(case='compile_failure_preserved_when_cleanup_blocked',firstFailure=first,cleanup=cleanup['status'],signals=[]))


ns['pathlib']=pathlib
ns['EDITOR']='/fixture/Unity.app/Contents/MacOS/Unity'
commands={71:'dotnet exec /fixture/Unity.app/Contents/DotNetSdkRoslyn/VBCSCompiler.dll',72:'dotnet exec /foreign/compiler.dll'}
ns['current_identity']=lambda pid:dict(command=commands[pid])
family=ns['unity_rows']([dict(pid=71,ppid=1,comm='dotnet'),dict(pid=72,ppid=1,comm='dotnet')])
assert [r['pid'] for r in family]==[71]
cases.append(dict(case='unowned_Unity_SDK_detection',familyPids=[r['pid'] for r in family],foreignToolIncluded=False))


# Run only the actual log probe against retained FIX18 logs; no process or new output is created.
probe_node=next(n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='compile_failure')
import re
ns.update(OUT=root/'TestArtifacts/FightMatch/UGUI-01/q4-correction-18',MAX_LOG=8*1024*1024,re=re)
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[probe_node],type_ignores=[]),'FIX19 retained-log probe','exec'),ns)
probe=ns['compile_failure']()
assert probe and 'CS0234' in probe['line'] and 'FightMatchTestProgressCallback.cs(107,68)' in probe['line']
clock=Clock(7)
outcome=monitor(lambda:None,ns['compile_failure'],lambda:None,clock.wait,clock.now,600)
assert outcome['kind']=='COMPILE_FAILURE' and outcome['elapsedSeconds']==7
cases.append(dict(case='actual_compile_probe_against_retained_FIX18_log',probe=probe,firstFailure=outcome['kind'],realProcessesStarted=0))

assert text.count("run['firstFailure']=")==1
assert "checks=dict(exitZero=process.returncode==0" in text
assert "xmlExact190Passed=current_xml['passed']" in text
assert "finishedCounterExact190=finished_counter==collections.Counter(expected)" in text
assert "realRunFinished=trace['runFinished']==1" in text
assert "first_kind=(run.get('firstFailure') or {}).get('kind')" in text
print(json.dumps(dict(status='OFFLINE_BRANCH_CHECKS_PASS',caseCount=len(cases),cases=cases,
                     realProcessesStarted=0,UnityStarted=False,productionTestsRun=False,
                     isolatedFunctions=sorted(names),actualFIX18RegressionReproduced=True,
                     note='Only AST-extracted lifecycle/identity functions and the old wait fragment were executed with fake clocks and process facts. No full runner import or subprocess call.'),ensure_ascii=False))
